snippet.title: Bylina - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Bylina on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2461440/Bylina

Enter a world of Slavic myth and medieval adventure. As a young bogatyr, journey to the Thrice-Nine Kingdom, challenge Koschei the Deathless, and save your immortal soul in Bylina – an epic action-adventure rooted in Slavic folklore, with a heavy focus on skill-based combat.

Join on Discord → https://discord.gg/bylinagame
Follow on X → https://twitter.com/bylinagame
Watch on TikTok → https://www.tiktok.com/@bylina_game
Explore on Instagram → https://instagram.com/bylina.game
